fields.statement: Verifier at 56d15968: read the diff (inboxItems lists live runs' permission-blocked sessions via runPermissionAll over session.Resolve, including autonomous runs; itemTab now uses the session tab for kind permission; daemonNotify passes blocked/tabOf and inboxNotice adds the detail; webInboxKinds and the web labels include permission). Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-permission|daemon-notify-hook|inbox-stalled|inbox-open|describe-golden)$' -count=1: all PASS. inbox-permission.txtar covers the permission item (session, run, step, detail, tab, next=rhiza inbox open) in an owner run and an autonomous run, no item after a newer Rex idle report, no question for an autonomous run's question block, and inbox open focusing block:sess in session:s2 rather than block:root. daemon-notify-hook writes one permission line with the detail in RHIZA_INBOX_TITLE. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp -run 'TestRowPerItemInOrder|TestOtherKindShowsDetailAndOpensTab': PASS, including the permission row with its detail and Enter calling inbox.open k2. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWebInbox|TestInbox': every test PASS, including TestWebInboxViewsPermission. The package then failed only on the root-state guard, because the live root daemon rewrote ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json; its mtime also changes with no test running, so this is unrelated to the change. go test ./internal/web: PASS.
